meta.tagline: 几千条从最佳路径算出来的墨色风线，画出超强台风摩羯的一生：在南海睁开风眼，在文昌登陆，在越南散开，一整周最后收成一条线。

spec.upstream_line: Thousands of ink wind lines, computed from the best track, draw Super Typhoon Yagi: the eye opening over the South China Sea, the landfall on Hainan, the spiral coming apart in Vietnam, and a whole week folded into one last line.
spec.sample_note: 演示站短片暂为早期外部样片，后续换成本仓库 projects/ 出片
spec.engine_note: 黑底加色：描线分多遍叠加，亮芯压在光晕上，暗角收边。
